item.title: Simonyan says Karabakh is Azerbaijan’s territory
item.description: Simonyan added that “anyone speaking negatively about the Prague process does not want Armenia to exist as an independent state.”

item.title: Court eases restraint on Narek Samsonyán
item.description: “Administrative supervision has been imposed with a ban on public speech,” Melikyan noted.

item.title: Officials discuss expanding UN cooperation
item.description: Armenian deputy FM and UN Women representative reviewed cooperation progress and discussed expanding joint initiatives.

item.title: Prison deaths point to systemic failures, monitor says
item.description: Armenian prison watchdog and ombudsman representative raise alarm over rising deaths in detention facilities.

item.title: Families seek answers on 44-day war findings
item.description: Relatives of missing soldiers and activists rally outside parliament, demanding publication of the 44-day war report.

item.title: Opposition MP says authorities exploit war fears
item.description: Abrahamyan criticizes Armenian authorities for leveraging war fears in politics, warning of rising tensions.

item.title: Rights activist slams secrecy of war report
item.description: Nina Karapetyants accuses authorities of politicizing the war report, saying victims’ families were misled.

item.title: Ruling MP warns opposition risks peace collapse
item.description: Konjoryan said that Armenia’s second president, Robert Kocharyan, is a “constant instigator of war.

item.title: Lawyer warns of limited data on prisoners’ health
item.description: “Not only have we lost access to fragmented visual information, but even that limited data is disappearing,” Sahakyan said.

item.title: Armenia deploys guards at closed Akhurik crossing
item.description: Armenian border troops are deployed at a non-operational checkpoint, while Russian forces continue guarding the Armenia–Turkey border.
